name: BC-MCR blind-center masked-context repair - structural synthesis gate (doc 21 s6.3)
context: RSR Oracle audit FAIL (g3/g4: pool unbalanced, LLSE 97%) -> doc 21 Phase 4 branches to BC-MCR to create a NEW structural evidence expert. This R0 runs the s6.3 structural-synthesis gate ONLY on normal material; if it fails, BC-MCR is archived and real anomalies are never touched.
space: fused A1 grid (dino vitb14 + clip w=0.5 concat, per-patch L2), 32x32, MPDD seed0 shot2 (two reference images, same as D2 diagnostic so AUROC numbers are comparable to the documented A4/RG-MCR results)

data_normality.train: ONLY the S=2 normal support reference grids of each class (interior cells with full 7x7 window); no test images, no GT
data_normality.score: normal test/good grids (never bad, never GT) synthetically perturbed exactly as D2: permutation(swap 4x4 blocks) / missing(block wiped to its own spatial mean) / duplicate(4x4 block copied), block size 4, mask dilated 1, donor = adjacent good grid, seeded rng (D2 parity)
data_normality.label: synthetic perturbation mask only

method.model: per-class tiny net (<0.8M params): context slots -> Linear(1536->128)+LN, learned 7x7 relative-position embedding, 2-layer cross-attention over query-context tokens (blind: 7x7 minus center 3x3 = 40 cells) + support top-M context tokens (faiss by context-mean over the 2 refs), head Linear(128->1536); score = 1 - cos(predicted center, actual center); loss = mean(1-cos)
method.training: masked-center reconstruction on the 2 refs; spatial leave-region-out validation block (no adjacent train/val centres), early stop on val cosine; Adam, CPU

controls.CTRL-COPY: context includes the centre 3x3 (49 slots) - tests blindness
controls.CTRL-CTX: query context only, no support tokens - tests support conditioning
controls.CTRL-POS: no trained model: old fixed retrieval (D2 context_residual: centre of the memory patch whose ring matches) - the RG-MCR baseline
controls.CTRL-SHUFFLE: FULL with (context, centre) pairs shuffled during training

gates.g1: per-type mean patch-AUROC (over 6 MPDD categories) >= 0.75 for ALL of permutation/missing/duplicate
gates.g2: each type >= A1 patch-AUROC + 0.10 (mean over categories)
gates.g4_controls: FULL >= each control on every type (no control matches)
gates.g5: FULL - best control averaged over the three types >= +0.05
gates.stop_rule: doc 21 s6.3: if gate fails, ARCHIVE BC-MCR; real-anomaly MPDD gate (s6.4) is only reachable after this gate passes

leakage: no GT, no bad images, no test aggregates in any training/feature
leakage.control_semantics: CTRL-POS equals the archived D2/RG-MCR non-parametric method, so g3 directly tests whether the trained blind predictor fixes the missing case
